transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the S-6. Before we finalize the communications annex and assign the relay kits this morning, I want to make sure we're all aligned. We have two portable relay kits available — Kit A and Kit B. Both the northern liaison site and the southern command post need a relay kit from 0800 through 1600 today. That gives us exactly two kits for two sites, so we need to confirm there are no other requirements or maintenance issues before I sign the annex. Does anyone have additional information I should be aware of?

So Kit B needs to be assigned to the northern liaison site, and Kit A goes to the southern command post.
